name: Moji Open Graph social card by Moji
description: A 1200×630 share card split into two zones: a paper-white identity column on the left and a tilted dark-mode app screenshot floating over a sumi-e ink-wash texture on the right. Hierarchy on the left runs brush-drawn mark → red seal stamp → high-contrast serif wordmark → letterspaced caps tagline with one red keyword → a hairline-divided four-icon feature row → repo URL, all locked to a single left margin. The palette is strictly paper white, ink black and seal red (the stamp motif repeats top-left and bottom-right), so the dark UI panel carries all the contrast weight and the card reads instantly at thumbnail size.
